values.note: Sewer at site 42 only (Chestnut Loop, accessible). 50-amp only in Black Oak and Chestnut; Acorn Loop is 20/30-amp.

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/bear-creek-lake ('RV35 - Electric-water sites ... accepts 20, 30 and 50-amp current'; 'Site 42 provides a sewer connection and it is handicap accessible') + https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/camping-fees ('Electric, Water and Sewer (site 42 only)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Only 11 sites take RVs: RV 21, 24, 25, 28, 29, 30, 32, 34 (Black Oak) and 42, 44, 45 (Chestnut), to 35 ft COMBINED tow vehicle + trailer. The other E/W sites hold pop-ups/equipment to 20 ft; Acorn sites 4-13 are water-view tent-only sites without hookups and site 18 is a tent-only E/W site. Acorn is the only loop by the lake.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/bear-creek-lake ('The only RV sites are RV 21, 24, 25, 28, 29, 30, 32, 34, 42, 44, and 45'; 'the 35ft size limit is the combined length of the tow vehicle and trailer'; 'Total: 45 sites'; 'In Acorn Loop, the only campground by the lake, there are 10 water view tent sites ... There are also seven sites there that offer no view of the water, but they have electric and water hookups to accommodate popups and equipment up to 20 feet long'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Showers in the Acorn and Chestnut loop bathhouses; Wi-Fi year-round in the campground; nearest public laundry 7 miles away in Cumberland Court House. Firewood shed at the Acorn Loop entrance.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/bear-creek-lake ('Showers in Acorn and Chestnut loops'; 'Wi-Fi is available year-round in the campground'; 'The closest public laundry is 7 miles away in Cumberland Court House'; amenities list 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First Friday in March through the first Monday in December (opened 3/6 in 2026). Chestnut Loop is open through October 31; Black Oak Loop begins closing by the second week of November for the Lights at the Lake setup.

season.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/bear-creek-lake ('Camping is available from the first Friday in March until the first Monday in December'; 'The Chestnut loop is open through October 31'; 'Black Oak Camping loop begins closing annually by the second week of November'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/bear-creek-lake ('All campsites at the park allow site-specific reservations. Reserve campsites through the Reservation Center - 800-933-7275 option 5 or online'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed fees on DCR's table ($37 E/W, $43 site 42 full hookup) and the inherited reservable/ReserveVAParks booking.
